query:
SELECT
            c.id, c.title,
            c.type AS chunk_type,
            (1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::text::vector))::float8 AS "similarity!"
        FROM chunk c
        WHERE c.user_id = $2
          AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL
          AND ($3::text IS NULL OR c.id <> $3)
        ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1::text::vector
        LIMIT $4
